Short enough to be enjoyable. If it was any longer, it might get boring and repetitive.
I like the fact that you can see you're endgame from the start of the game. 

Sometimes I just want some mindless action, not to much strategies, just duck, move, shoot and smash. 

The lore is great, the setting is great (very Quak II -ish), skulls everywhere. 

Graphics are ok, but good for it's age. 
Aged well btw. 

Not enough variety in weapons or enemies, but still fun to bash some demon heads in with an electric hammer. 

I like it, and I would recommend it.
A very fun and nice game.

Wanna rip and tear Orks apart in the Warhammer 40,000 universe? Wanna regain health by stepping on faces? Wanna wear armor so heavy that every footfall causes a damn earthquake? [i] Then this is the game for you. [/i]

Combat is fun for a short period of time. For a free game the single player and online co-op will suffice. The history is so bland, couldn't care less. I don't know the Warhammer and this game did not help much. I was interested in Warhammer tabletop rpg, in particular Only War and Fantasy corebooks, I decide to take a look at the game  i had in my library, now i don't want waste time looking at the books. kek.
